title: Typed order lifecycle
statement: Implement the closed order lifecycle described by the required declarations. Legal transitions are draft + submit -> submitted, draft + cancel -> cancelled, submitted + pay -> paid, submitted + cancel -> cancelled, paid + ship -> shipped, and paid + cancel -> cancelled. A disallowed event in draft, submitted, or paid returns event_not_allowed. Every event applied to shipped or cancelled returns terminal_state.
constraints: represent states, events, errors, and accepted/rejected outcomes with the exact declared types rather than untyped strings or numbers
handle every declared state and event variant explicitly; do not use a catch-all or default branch
return a typed rejected outcome for illegal transitions; do not throw, panic, or perform input/output
do not add tests or weaken, cast around, or suppress the required static types

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

enum OrderState:
    draft
    submitted
    paid
    shipped
    cancelled

enum OrderEvent:
    submit
    pay
    ship
    cancel

enum TransitionError:
    event_not_allowed
    terminal_state

enum TransitionResult:
    accepted(state: OrderState)
    rejected(error: TransitionError)

function transition(state: OrderState, event: OrderEvent) returns TransitionResult

forbidden_patterns.message: catch-all match arms are forbidden; handle every Jett enum variant explicitly

python.signature:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class OrderState(Enum):
    DRAFT = auto()
    SUBMITTED = auto()
    PAID = auto()
    SHIPPED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

class OrderEvent(Enum):
    SUBMIT = auto()
    PAY = auto()
    SHIP = auto()
    CANCEL = auto()

class TransitionError(Enum):
    EVENT_NOT_ALLOWED = auto()
    TERMINAL_STATE = auto()

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Accepted:
    state: OrderState

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rejected:
    error: TransitionError

type TransitionResult = Accepted | Rejected

def transition(state: OrderState, event: OrderEvent) -> TransitionResult
